source.quote_free_summary: Decisions of the judges, Contest Coordinator and Event Director are final; a complaint or challenge to a panel or its results is made after the event and goes to the Judge Review Board.

requirement: DanceFlow does not adjudicate formal challenges and must say so wherever the correction flow appears; a Judge Review Board outcome is never an input.
interpretation_notes: Whether an organizer may amend a UCWDC result after the event is NOT SPECIFIED in the provided source; the Judge Certification Code of Conduct was not provided. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-07 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
